messages:
sam: noticing ~3% SSO failures for tenant `verdant` since 05:12Z. Error in auth proxy: "KMS decrypt failed: context mismatch tenant:verdant:extid". Users get a sign-in loop.

neha: did we rotate keys for that tenant last night?

sam: yes, scheduled rotation completed 04:58Z. KMS shows success. proxy excerpt: `saml decrypt: invalid_envelope_header {"kid":"jwk-v3"}`.

brian: sounds like a metadata/cache mismatch: some IdP instances or edge proxies are still handing out assertions encrypted for previous kid. If envelope context encoding changed (we added tenant suffix) that causes KMS to reject.

idp-bot: :warning: idp-cache-check found 5/12 replicas with stale jwk reference. auto-refresh queued.

ops-oncall: short mitigation: 1) restart idp pods to force metadata refresh; 2) flush edge metadata cache entries; 3) monitor auth error rate. Which first?

neha: restart idp pool first, safer than rolling key rollback. Also prepare a rewrap plan if restarts and cache flush don't clear failures.

sam: rolling restart done. errors dropped to ~0.2% but a few still log old kid. those hit our legacy proxy that caches metadata 10m. flushing it now.

brian: follow-up: add pre-rotation hook to publish jwk and ensure fleet-wide metadata refresh before swapping KMS alias. And add an audit event for any envelope rewraps.

ops-oncall: filed a short incident note with timeline and commands used. Will keep watch for 30m; escalate if >1% failures.

sam: confirmed. root cause = rotation/metadata refresh race + proxy TTL. mitigation = idp restart + cache flush. follow-up = rewrap dry-run + runbook change.
